answer.rationale: Expiring primary contract plus 94% utilization and no buffer make a full primary switch too likely to raise delivery risk, even though c2 reports a prior low-cost move with quick onboarding. The low-cost quote that alone hits the 18% mandate is leverage; c4 shows benchmarking at renewal previously moved the incumbent on price and terms, and c1 shows incumbent renewal preserved integration and deliveries. Negotiate against that quote rather than switch or defer. Unverified whether the incumbent can actually concede 18% in 14 days or whether last year's onboarding would repeat under zero buffer.
